evals.prompt: Make a cinematic 30-second TVC for a running shoe: dawn city streets, one runner, a score. Take it to the first Seedance drafts.
evals.expected_output: A staged plan that develops the product-linked idea, records the source count and audio route, and takes only authorized sources to requested 480p drafts.
expectations: Runs brief-intake first and preserves native audio unchanged unless a separate soundtrack is explicitly requested; records ungraded original colours and logo/end card as post overlays in project.md.
Develops hook, motivation, progression, payoff and product role before coverage; records internal shots separately from authorized source generations.

Submits only authorized sources as requested 480p drafts with verified native Draft and audio support, after registration and mode-appropriate review, without requiring a run budget, known price or spending approval.
Plans shot count, holds or moves and timing around readable beats and authorized source counts; no cadence, variety, turn or wow quota applies.
Plans sound/editorial attention and payoff before generation and defines brief-specific artistic criteria for actual playback.
Does not bind any storyboard image as a Seedance reference.

evals.prompt: The drafts are approved. Make the finals at 1080p, and tighten the second shot's prompt a little while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: Promotes unchanged approved drafts by draft_task_id and routes the prompt change through a new Draft instead of a promotion.
expectations: Promotes only the selected, unchanged Drafts with draft_task_id, resolution and watermark.
Treats the prompt change as a new reviewed 480p Draft, not an edit to a promotion.
Re-inspects every final, including a fresh speech-to-text and listening pass, before replacing drafts in Studio.

evals.prompt: Assemble the approved takes into the master. Make it look cinematic.
evals.expected_output: An ungraded assembly in original colours unless a look is recorded, with exact-length intermediates and a Studio render.
expectations: Keeps original Seedance colours and asks or records before adding any grade, grain, halation or vignette, because no look is locked in the brief.

Builds exact-length lossless intermediates, joins with the concat demuxer and encodes once; chooses decoding from actual pix_fmt, color_range, color_primaries, color_transfer and color_space rather than a model-family assumption.
Unknown or conflicting stream metadata remains unresolved; full-range SDR and HDR require their own measured decode/transform decisions.
Places the result in Studio and renders the master with studio_project.py render; adds no AI label or default audio normalization, fades, carving, padding or trimming.

evals.prompt: In the final master, the narrator mispronounces one product name in shot 3. Re-dub the narration.
evals.expected_output: An explicitly requested narration dub that preserves protected picture and non-voice sound; word surgery is not mandatory.
expectations: Honors the requested dub extent, offering a narrower repair only as an alternative rather than imposing a word splice.
Verifies words, voice and timing by transcript and listening without mandatory gain, fades or normalization.
Keeps protected music, ambience and picture; any attachment preserves independent audio tails and records derivative provenance.
Returns the affected picture/audio locks to review and re-renders in Studio.

evals.prompt: Extend shot 4, where the two leads walk away, by another 8 seconds using Seedance extension.
evals.expected_output: Explains that extension of clips with people needs asset:// Virtual Portrait identities and offers short single passes held by a blocking map otherwise.
expectations: Does not submit an extension of a clip with people unless the identities are registered asset:// Virtual Portrait assets.
Offers a new single-pass shot with matching first frame and a blocking map, assembled at a cut.
Does not submit a paid request before the user chooses the route.

evals.prompt: Review only: the assembled 12-second lamp reveal decodes and its transcript is correct, but no one has played or listened to it. The approved premise is that an offscreen click makes the viewer look for the lamp, revealed only at the end. Default review mode, approve_for_me. Can we lock it? No generation or extra spend.
evals.expected_output: An unresolved artistic review, with actual playback/listening required before selection and no fabricated pass.
expectations: Does not lock based only on decode, transcript, schema or agent approval authority.
Requests actual full-speed playback and listening with timestamps for attention, reveal timing and the click's audibility.
Checks that the final cut preserves the approved withholding and payoff without treating motion or a wow frame as mandatory.
Uses concise existing default-mode review evidence and existing lock writers, with no new runtime, paid generation or strict checklist mandate.

evals.prompt: Review the decode plan only in default and strict modes; do not transform media. All five masters are 10-bit. A measures yuv420p10le/tv/bt709/bt709/bt709. B is full-range BT.709 SDR. C has BT.2020 primaries and PQ transfer. D has BT.2020 primaries with SDR transfer. E has missing or conflicting range/transfer tags. We authorize an SDR delivery target only for A.
evals.expected_output: A measured per-stream plan, with the known limited-range BT.709 recipe applicable only to A and no automatic family-wide decode or transform for B through E.
expectations: Uses pix_fmt, color_range, color_primaries, color_transfer and color_space rather than model family or bit depth alone.
Applies the known limited-range BT.709 SDR recipe only to the exact measured A profile and authorized target.
Keeps B range-preserving; PQ or HLG with BT.2020 requires an HDR-preserving or explicitly authorized tone-mapping decision.
Does not treat BT.2020 SDR as BT.709 or apply A's matrix/range recipe to it.
Leaves E unresolved, preserves all source masters, and makes no transformation or playback-quality claim in either review mode.

evals.prompt: Finalize this approved native audiovisual take unchanged. Its music already sits under the voice, loudness is -24 LUFS, and its sound tail extends beyond the last picture frame. Do not edit audio.
evals.expected_output: Preserve native audio unchanged and its independent tail; no finishing processor is required.
expectations: Does not normalize, limit, carve, duck, fade, splice, pad, trim, extract, mux or replace the audio merely to finalize.
Keeps the source and reports any renderer/timeline conflict without silently truncating the tail.
Preserves actual inspection, Studio provenance and final-lock requirements separately from audio processing.

evals.prompt: Compare three instruction-only delivery scopes: A keeps native sound unchanged, B must be silent, C must use this exact supplied song master. No media generation or editing now.
evals.expected_output: Three separate scoped routes, with no invented blanket audio post-production requirement.
expectations: A needs no audio processing; B uses supported silence controls without adding a bed.
C verifies exact preservation and offers compatible stream-copy attachment only under that explicit scope, disclosing required transcoding or timeline changes.
Does not treat native generation as proof that a source song is preserved byte-for-byte, and does not use -shortest to hide independent tails.
Unknown operation support stays unresolved; no media is changed.

evals.prompt: Finalize our wordless native-sound ad. We have a clean decode and loudness measurements, but no tool or person can listen to it yet. Do not add generation or audio repair.
evals.expected_output: Keep audio unchanged and report listening validation as unresolved.
expectations: Does not mark listening passed from decode, loudness, waveform or ASR alone.
Does not replace native sound with a post bed, word surgery or a normalization pass.
Requests actual permitted listening evidence before the existing final acceptance gate.
